role.title: Senior Functional Consultant
role.role_basis: O*NET 15-1211.00 Computer Systems Analysts / ESCO 'ICT application configurator' occupation (senior functional-consultant profile)
role.context_note: Currently a Functional Consultant Level 3 (software consultancy, 4-7 yrs; software/product knowledge, configuration troubleshooting, workshop facilitation, mentoring junior consultants); growing into cross-functional expertise, solution design leadership, trusted advisory, solution evaluation -- a level 3-to-4 progression within the same track. role_title cleaned from their literal Q9 answer "Functional Consultant Level 4" (an internal grade, not an external job-ad title) into a standard seniority label.

courses.title: Solution Design Leadership in Practice
courses.description: Solution Design Leadership in Practice focuses on solution design leadership for people working toward a Senior Functional Consultant role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces configuration troubleshooting, enough to apply alongside solution design leadership in real Senior Functional Consultant work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to solution design leadership and show how configuration troubleshooting supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying solution design leadership to a real Senior Functional Consultant scenario
Practicing solution design leadership through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to configuration troubleshooting
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Solution Evaluation
courses.description: Applying Solution Evaluation goes beyond the basics of solution evaluation, for people already working toward a Senior Functional Consultant role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in solution evaluation and want to go further.

courses.title: Getting Started with Requirements Gathering
courses.description: Getting Started with Requirements Gathering is a short introduction to requirements gathering for people moving toward a Senior Functional Consultant role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show requirements gathering in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if requirements gathering is new to you.

Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
